description: This is a Java test class for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing the behavior of pop-up text display (PopText) during keyboard input, correction, and suggestion interactions.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardPopTextTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing pop-up text behavior in AnySoftKeyboard.

methods.name: testDefaultPopTextOutOfKeyOnCorrection
methods.description: Tests that the default behavior correctly pops text out of the key upon correction.

methods.name: testWordRevert
methods.description: Verifies that the pop-up text appears correctly when reverting a word correction.

methods.name: testAllPopTextOutOfKeyOnKeyPressAndCorrection
methods.description: Checks that all characters are popped out of the key during correction when configured.

methods.name: testAllWordsPopTextOutOfKeyOnKeyPressAndCorrection
methods.description: Ensures that entire words are popped out of the key during correction based on settings.

methods.name: testRestorePrefOnServiceRestart
methods.description: Verifies that user preferences for pop text are restored after service restart.

methods.name: testDoesNotPopTextWhenManuallyPicked
methods.description: Ensures that manually selected suggestions do not trigger pop text.

methods.name: testDoesNotCrashOnPopTextWhenFunctionalKeyPress
methods.description: Checks that pressing functional keys does not cause crashes related to pop text.

methods.name: testNeverPopTextOut
methods.description: Verifies that when set to 'never', no pop text is displayed.

methods.name: testDefaultSwitchCaseSameAsNever
methods.description: Tests that an unrecognized setting defaults to 'never' behavior.

methods.name: verifyNothingAddedInteractions
methods.description: Helper method to verify no extra draw interactions were added.

methods.name: verifyPopText
methods.description: Helper method to verify that the specified pop text was drawn.
